zh: 只需要看第一个大写字母之前的那一段；没有大写字母时就是整段文本。
从头扫描，遇到第一个大写字母立即停止，途中把见到的小写字母放进集合去重。
用长度 26 的布尔数组代替集合：逐字符读，若是 A 到 Z 就停止；若是 a 到 z 且尚未标记，就标记并计数加一。整行读入（可能为空、含空格），最后输出计数。
en: Only the part before the first uppercase letter matters; if there is no uppercase letter, that is the whole text.
Scan from the start, stop at the first uppercase letter, and put the lowercase letters seen along the way into a set to remove duplicates.

Use a boolean array of 26 entries as the set: read character by character, stop on A to Z, and on a to z mark the letter and add one to the count if it was not marked yet. Read the whole line (it may be empty or contain spaces) and print the count.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Scan and stop at the first uppercase letter, adding the lowercase letters before it to a set.

## Proof of correctness

The scanned range is exactly the defined prefix, and the set removes duplicates, so the set's size is the number of distinct lowercase letters.

## Complexity

Time O(N), space O(26).
